event_description: A partner successfully creates a new property listing (server-side).
A partner submits a draft listing to go live for admin review (client-side).
An admin approves a pending-review listing to make it available (client-side).
A partner hard-deletes a listing and its photos (server-side).
A partner bumps a listing to refresh its sort position (client-side).
A partner confirms whether a listing is still available, reserved, or rented (client-side).
A partner creates a new contact/lead record, optionally linked to a listing (server-side).
A partner deletes a contact and unlinks their deals (server-side).
A partner links a contact to a listing, creating a deal pipeline entry (server-side).
A partner saves a social-media post draft caption for a listing (client-side).
A partner or admin generates an invite link for a new team member (client-side).
A new team member accepts their invite and joins the studio (client-side).
A partner successfully completes the Facebook OAuth flow and connects their Page (server-side).
A partner disconnects their Facebook Page integration from the studio (client-side).
A partner publishes a listing caption and selected photos to their connected Facebook Page from Promote (server + client). Properties: listing_id, photo_count, group_count.
Partner opens the Publish on Facebook overlay from a listing Promote tab.
Partner starts the guided group posting flow after optional Page publish. Properties: listing_id, group_count, posted_to_page.
Partner marks a Facebook group as posted during the guided blast. Properties: listing_id, group_id.
Server records a guided group post against listing history. Properties: listing_id, has_group_id.
Partner clears Facebook post history for a listing (all or older than N days). Properties: listing_id, cleared, older_than_days.
Partner adds a Facebook group URL (Settings or Promote overlay). Optional property: source=promote_overlay.
A user signs into Partner Studio via password or magic link (client-side). Property: method (password | magic_link).
User clicked Apply to become a partner from the Partner Studio login page.
A partner saves company settings (name, logo, phone, WhatsApp/Zalo, email) in Settings (server + client).
A partner uploads a company logo image in Settings before saving.
A partner removes the company logo in Settings before saving.
